'''Sun Gecko''' is a {{mcat|boss}} in the {{zone|Time Chamber}}, accessed by talking with [[Oruo The Almighty]] in the {{zone|Continuum}}. Each fight grants {{Item|Sun Gecko Essence|amount=5}} and {{gold|50 Sun Gecko Experience}} initially, but can be increased with Time Chamber Modifiers.

While fighting '''Sun Gecko''', {{Statname|Rift Time}} drains twice as fast.

== Trivia ==
*'''Sun Gecko''' most likely is a reference to [[fandom:Dragonball:Son Goku|Son Goku]] from the Dragon Ball franchise.
** '''Sun Gecko''' could also reference the historic Chinese military strategist, [[w:Sun_Tzu|Sun Tzu]].
*Beating '''Sun Gecko''' for the first time rewards the [[Achievements|"If you wish to defeat me..."]] Achievement.
** This achievement most likely originates from a phrase from Technoblade's video "''Skeppy vs Technoblade: The Final Reckoning''".
*Beating '''Sun Gecko''' with all {{Green|7}} Time Chamber Modifiers rewards the [[Achievements|Maximum Power]] Achievement.
*{{Item|Extremely Real Shuriken}}s can be used as a substitute for {{Item|Time Shuriken}}s to keep up the player's combo.
